items.criterion: The health route answers 200 on the public origin once the database, the bucket and the seed have all landed.
items.judgment: Read the health route over the public origin and compare the status against 200.

items.criterion: Each seeded account signs in with the corpus password and its stored role matches the role the session reports.
items.judgment: Sign in as each seeded account, read the session, and compare it against the stored account row.

items.criterion: An account created through signup is stored lowercased with a hashed password and the reader role.
items.judgment: Sign up with a mixed-case address and compare the stored row against the submitted values.

items.criterion: The statistics read answers five rows in position order with their pinned values, captions and measurement dates.
items.judgment: Read the statistics route and compare each row against the seeded five.

items.criterion: The capabilities read answers eight rows in position order, each carrying its claim and its pinned result line.
items.judgment: Read the capabilities route and compare each result line against the pinned eight.

items.criterion: The services read answers thirty-two rows split thirteen, six, seven and six across the four families.
items.judgment: Read the services route, count by family, and compare the sampled descriptions.

items.criterion: A family query answers only that family, in its own position order.
items.judgment: Read the services route narrowed to one family and compare the answered set.

items.criterion: Every seeded article is stored with its pinned title, its visibility and its owning author, and a draft carries no published date.
items.judgment: Read each seeded article row and compare it against the seeded table.

items.criterion: Every seeded table holds its own rows exactly once, so a restart writes nothing a second time.
items.judgment: Count the rows of each seeded table and compare against the seeded counts.

items.criterion: The press, events and partner reads answer their seeded rows in their stated order with their own fields.
items.judgment: Read the three secondary routes and compare the order and the fields.

items.criterion: The article index answers the three published articles newest first and neither draft.
items.judgment: Read the index and compare the answered slugs and their order.

items.criterion: An open article answers its category, title, author name, published date and full body with no session.
items.judgment: Read the open article with no session and compare the answered fields.

items.criterion: A members article answers its excerpt to a visitor with its body withheld.
items.judgment: Read the members article with no session and confirm the body is absent.

items.criterion: A members article answers its body to a signed-in reader.
items.judgment: Read the members article as the seeded reader and confirm the body is present.

items.criterion: A search answers ranked results carrying a title, the address it leads to and a short extract.
items.judgment: Read the search route with a query the site uses and compare the fields of each result.

items.criterion: No search answers a draft, to a visitor or to the author who owns it, and a query matching nothing answers an empty array.
items.judgment: Search for the draft title as both callers and compare the answered addresses.

items.criterion: An address matching no article answers not-found rather than a soft page.
items.judgment: Read an address the app does not have and compare the status against 404.

items.criterion: An attached cover exists in the bucket at the key the scheme derives from its own bytes, and the article record holds that key.
items.judgment: Attach a cover, derive the key from the bytes, and read the object out of the bucket.

items.criterion: A replaced cover is a second object at a new key, and the article record then holds the new key.
items.judgment: Replace a cover, read the second object out of the bucket, and compare the recorded key.

items.criterion: A published cover streams from the app to a caller with no session and matches the stored bytes.
items.judgment: Publish an article carrying a cover and read the cover with no session.

items.criterion: Publishing records the published date and returning to draft clears it and removes the article from every public route.
items.judgment: Move one article through both visibilities and compare the stored date and the public index each time.

items.criterion: One visitor key holds exactly one stored cookie choice, and a second answer replaces the first.
items.judgment: Record two answers under one key and count the stored rows.

items.criterion: A draft is refused by its own address to a visitor, a reader and the other author, and answered to the author who owns it.
items.judgment: Read the draft by slug as each caller and compare the statuses.

items.criterion: A draft is refused by its stored identifier as firmly as by its address.
items.judgment: Read the draft by identifier as each caller and compare the statuses.

items.criterion: A draft cover is refused to a visitor and to the other author while the owning author is streamed it.
items.judgment: Read the draft cover as each caller and compare the statuses.

items.criterion: Each desk list answers only the signed-in author's own articles, drafts included.
items.judgment: Read both desks and compare the answered slugs against each author's own set.

items.criterion: A reader session is refused the desk list and the article write by the server.
items.judgment: Read the desk list and post an article as the seeded reader and compare the statuses.

items.criterion: A caller with no session is refused the desk list and the article write.
items.judgment: Read the desk list and post an article with no session and compare the statuses.

items.criterion: A write aimed at another author's article is refused and the article is stored exactly as it was.
items.judgment: Attempt the write as the other author and compare the stored visibility before and after.

items.criterion: A signup body naming the author role still stores a reader, and only the two seeded accounts carry the author role.
items.judgment: Sign up with a role field in the body and compare the stored role and the author count.

items.criterion: A token stops being accepted the moment its holder signs out.
items.judgment: Use one token before and after a sign-out and compare the statuses.

items.criterion: Each of the five named consumer mailboxes is refused at signup with the email field named and no account stored.
items.judgment: Sign up at each named domain and compare the status and the stored account set.

items.criterion: A second signup on one address is refused and exactly one account remains stored.
items.judgment: Sign up twice on one address and count the stored accounts.

items.criterion: A sign-in with the wrong password is refused and hands back no token.
items.judgment: Sign in with a wrong password and compare the status and the response body.

items.criterion: A write reusing a slug another article holds is refused with the slug field named and stores nothing.
items.judgment: Post an article carrying a seeded slug and count the stored rows for that slug.

items.criterion: A write missing a title, missing a body or naming an unknown visibility is refused with the field named and stores nothing.
items.judgment: Post each malformed article in turn and confirm no row was written.
